# generated by tools/budgets/make_block_sdc.py sdc hfd_svc_SE_s6 --mode signoff from its budget sheet
# vclk at the sheet insertion 558 ps (measured: closure-loop calibrate hbm_svc_SE_s6_41d574827_bud (ot-pve1:/srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/closure-loop/hbm_svc_SE_s6_41d574827_bud)); target 814.9 ps; die entry target SS {'mean': 2459.3, 'min': 2459.3, 'max': 2459.3}
create_clock -name vclk -period [get_property [get_clocks core_clk] period]
set_clock_uncertainty -setup 60 [get_clocks {core_clk vclk}]
set_clock_uncertainty -hold 25 [get_clocks {core_clk vclk}]
set_clock_latency 558 [get_clocks vclk]
# sign-off times the routed clock tree: real clock stays propagated (make_block_sdc fix 2026-10-07)
set ot_in [all_inputs -no_clocks]
unset_input_delay -clock core_clk $ot_in
unset_output_delay -clock core_clk [all_outputs]
# ei input 54b: L 0.2 um (pins), intra skew 38
set_input_delay 168.2 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {ei ei[*]}]
set_input_delay -min 32.2 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {ei ei[*]}]
# eo output 550b: L 0.2 um (pins), intra skew 38
set_output_delay 109.2 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {eo eo[*]}]
set_output_delay -min -15 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {eo eo[*]}]
# phy input 1866b: L 8.7 um (outline), inter skew 150
set_input_delay 289.8 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {phy phy[*]}]
set_input_delay -min 33.2 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {phy phy[*]}]
# wi input 376b: L 0.2 um (pins), intra skew 38
set_input_delay 168.2 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {wi wi[*]}]
set_input_delay -min 32.2 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {wi wi[*]}]
# wo output 558b: L 0.2 um (pins), intra skew 38
set_output_delay 109.2 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {wo wo[*]}]
set_output_delay -min -15 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {wo wo[*]}]
# reset release (rst_mcp2, as make_io_vclk.sh)
set ot_rst {}
foreach ot_c [get_cells *] { if {[string match {rst_s\[1\]*} [get_full_name $ot_c]]} { lappend ot_rst $ot_c } }
if {[llength $ot_rst]} { set_multicycle_path -setup 2 -from $ot_rst; set_multicycle_path -hold 1 -from $ot_rst }
set_propagated_clock [get_clocks {core_clk}]

if {[llength [get_libs -quiet *_FF_*]]} {
# generated by tools/budgets/make_block_sdc.py ff hfd_svc_SE_s6: FF hold sign-off post-SDC (sheet insertion FF min 330 / max 408, 50 ps hold IO uncertainty)
set_clock_latency 330 [get_clocks vclk]
create_clock -name vclki -period [get_property [get_clocks core_clk] period]
set_clock_latency 408 [get_clocks vclki]
unset_input_delay -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {ei ei[*]}]
set_input_delay 168.2 -clock vclki [get_ports -quiet {ei ei[*]}]
set_input_delay -min 32.2 -clock vclki [get_ports -quiet {ei ei[*]}]
unset_input_delay -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {phy phy[*]}]
set_input_delay 289.8 -clock vclki [get_ports -quiet {phy phy[*]}]
set_input_delay -min 33.2 -clock vclki [get_ports -quiet {phy phy[*]}]
unset_input_delay -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {wi wi[*]}]
set_input_delay 168.2 -clock vclki [get_ports -quiet {wi wi[*]}]
set_input_delay -min 32.2 -clock vclki [get_ports -quiet {wi wi[*]}]
set_clock_uncertainty -hold 50 -from [get_clocks vclki] -to [get_clocks core_clk]
set_clock_uncertainty -hold 50 -from [get_clocks core_clk] -to [get_clocks vclk]
}

cl/budget_signoff.sdc.text:
# generated by tools/budgets/make_block_sdc.py sdc hfd_svc_SE_s6 --mode signoff from its budget sheet
# vclk at the sheet insertion 558 ps (measured: closure-loop calibrate hbm_svc_SE_s6_41d574827_bud (ot-pve1:/srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/closure-loop/hbm_svc_SE_s6_41d574827_bud)); target 814.9 ps; die entry target SS {'mean': 2459.3, 'min': 2459.3, 'max': 2459.3}
create_clock -name vclk -period [get_property [get_clocks core_clk] period]
set_clock_uncertainty -setup 60 [get_clocks {core_clk vclk}]
set_clock_uncertainty -hold 25 [get_clocks {core_clk vclk}]
set_clock_latency 558 [get_clocks vclk]
# sign-off times the routed clock tree: real clock stays propagated (make_block_sdc fix 2026-10-07)
set ot_in [all_inputs -no_clocks]
unset_input_delay -clock core_clk $ot_in
unset_output_delay -clock core_clk [all_outputs]
# ei input 54b: L 0.2 um (pins), intra skew 38
set_input_delay 168.2 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {ei ei[*]}]
set_input_delay -min 32.2 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {ei ei[*]}]
# eo output 550b: L 0.2 um (pins), intra skew 38
set_output_delay 109.2 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {eo eo[*]}]
set_output_delay -min -15 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {eo eo[*]}]
# phy input 1866b: L 8.7 um (outline), inter skew 150
set_input_delay 289.8 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {phy phy[*]}]
set_input_delay -min 33.2 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {phy phy[*]}]
# wi input 376b: L 0.2 um (pins), intra skew 38
set_input_delay 168.2 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {wi wi[*]}]
set_input_delay -min 32.2 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {wi wi[*]}]
# wo output 558b: L 0.2 um (pins), intra skew 38
set_output_delay 109.2 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {wo wo[*]}]
set_output_delay -min -15 -clock vclk [get_ports -quiet {wo wo[*]}]
# reset release (rst_mcp2, as make_io_vclk.sh)
set ot_rst {}
foreach ot_c [get_cells *] { if {[string match {rst_s\[1\]*} [get_full_name $ot_c]]} { lappend ot_rst $ot_c } }
if {[llength $ot_rst]} { set_multicycle_path -setup 2 -from $ot_rst; set_multicycle_path -hold 1 -from $ot_rst }
set_propagated_clock [get_clocks {core_clk}]
